notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611664/5007fadc091d2ef615a2abe211641624859beea6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]4Story: The Original – September 24 Update[/b][/p][p]Heroes, prepare yourselves! The upcoming update will bring exciting new content and challenges to 4Story: The Original.[/p][p][/p][h3]🔥 Update Highlights[/h3][olist][*][p][b]Level Cap Increase[/b] – Push your limits with a new maximum level of [b]99[/b]![/p][/*][*][p][b]Mentor-Mentee System[/b] – Team up and grow stronger together with the new mentoring feature.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Clarsus Mountain Map[/b] – Explore the newly added Clarsus Mountain, full of dangers and secrets.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dragon Raid[/b] – Face the mighty dragons in an epic new raid battle![/p][/*][/olist][p]Join the adventure, rise to new heights, and claim your glory![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611664/707c3d1820560be3875fe0e090e58c0d71bc5172.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Also, enjoy the coupon rotation for select cash items in the shop. notes.title: Level Cap Increase and Mihur Map Coming July 30 – Reach Level 89!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611664/5007fadc091d2ef615a2abe211641624859beea6.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Level Cap Increase and Mihur Map Coming July 30 – Reach Level 89![/b][/h2][p]We’re thrilled to announce that the [b]maximum level cap will be increased to Level 89[/b] starting [b]July 30[/b]! This exciting update will not only allow for greater character progression and high-level challenges but will also [b]unlock the Mihur map and the Level 80 Mission Map[/b], giving you brand-new areas to explore and conquer.[/p][p]Whether you’re catching up or already at the top of your game, now is the ideal moment to dive in — especially with our [b]ongoing 200% Upgrade Event and EXP Event[/b]! Take advantage of these powerful boosts to enhance your gear and gain experience at lightning speed.[/p][p]The increased level cap and new maps are the perfect chance to push past your limits, team up with allies, and test your strength against tougher foes. Don’t miss this opportunity to grow stronger and prepare for the adventures ahead![/p][p]Mark your calendars for [b]July 30[/b], and get ready to set foot on Mihur and beyond![/p][p]Plus![/p][p]There will be a change in wartime.[/p][p]One more Battle of Worlds and Aerial Wars will be added. And Aerial Wars will be changed from Weekly to Daily.[/p][p]Come see how it will be changed![/p]

notes.title: We are relaunching 4Story : The Original in June 11th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611664/5007fadc091d2ef615a2abe211641624859beea6.png[/img]4Story : The Original is making its grand return—and it’s happening in just a few weeks! Whether you're a seasoned warrior or a newcomer eager to explore a world filled with magic, battles, and legendary quests, this is your moment to be part of something special from the very beginning.

But we can't do it without you.

We need passionate players like you to help us spread the word and build the hype! Rally your friends, guildmates, and fellow gamers—because the more support we gather now, the more everyone will benefit when the game launches.

🛡️ How You Can Help
Head over to our store page and click the “Add to your wishlist” button. It only takes a second, but it makes a huge difference!

🎁 Wishlist Milestone Rewards
As a token of our appreciation, we're giving out in-game rewards to ALL players who join us at launch—based on how many wishlists we reach together!

For every 5,000 wishlists, all players will receive 10 Upgrade Protection items—essential tools to power up your gear without risk! These items will be delivered directly to your account on launch day, so you’ll be fully equipped to charge into battle the moment the servers go live.

🔥 The more people who wishlist, the bigger the rewards. So don’t keep it to yourself—spread the word and let's make this launch legendary!

Mark your calendar. Invite your crew. Add to your wishlist today.
The world of 4Story Original awaits!
